propositions: The enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count) because pending_enrichment walks every ticket directory and calls reduce_ticket, issuing ~24,000 metadata syscalls per write against a 20 ms budget; actual cost is 486-740 ms on a quiet 4,710+ ticket store, a 25x overrun.
The gate warning fires on 100% of writes, making it noise and rendering genuine future breaches invisible to operators.

Concurrent gate checks from multiple agents contend on vnode cache saturation rather than CPU, causing super-linear latency scaling (up to 6.3x with 16 concurrent walkers) and turning self-contention into a positive-feedback loop.

The fix introduces an O(1) marker file .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next_eligible_ns and written_ns to prove the store quiet without walking all tickets, degrading to a full scan on marker absence or corruption.
Invalidation of the marker sits in _append (the single funnel for ENQUEUE/CLAIM/DONE) so no queue mutation can hide behind it, and the marker expires after 10 minutes TTL for crash recovery.
